A floating '''medical facility''' on [[Adamastor]]'s oceans was run by the [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] before they decided to retire it. Several experimental medical devices abandoned by the Selkath have later been recovered from the facility.<ref>{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Scavenging|The Floating Hospital}}</ref>
